steps.name: Welcome. in this guide I give you a fairly optimal questing and skill training route for a vyrewatch alt
feel free to deviate from it and if you encounter any mistakes pls dm me on discord: heboxjonge (he box jonge#0494)
Complete tutorial island as a female. Don't forget 2FA for account security purposes.
Get membership either with a bond or irl money
Transfer about 100-200m gp and a ring of wealth (5) to your account(s) (200m+ if you are doing inquis helm route)
Teleport to Grand Exchange with ring of wealth
Buy some teleports, runes for early questing and buy some bones for 70 prayer (or higher)
Get 43 prayer or go to 70 if you feel like it (wildy or 330 poh)
Do early game quests (world 330 for someone's house for teleports)
Get 30 thieving while in ardy (can do Tribal totem at 21 thiev for 1775 xp)
tourist trap (use lamps on agility x2 )
Monkey madness (get the attack and defence training)
Unlock preserve (get 70 pray if you only got 43 at the start)
Buy combat gear: b ring, fury, manacles, granite hammer, Regen brace, (inquis helm), full obby + shield, sword and berserker necklace
Train melees to 65 att, 65 str and 60 def at sand crabs (granite hammer till 60 att, then d scim till 65/65/60 + use super combat pots
Get dragon defender (full obby + berserker neck) (train strength)

sections.section: NMZ & Sins of the Father prep

steps.name: NMZ your combats till a lvl that you feel comfortable doing sins of the father with (85 combat so you can use nieve is recommended)
Use black demon, tree spirit, khazard warlord, count draynor and bouncer
Darkness of Hallowvale (use xp reward on slayer x3)
A taste of hope (use xp reward on slayer x3)
Do Fremennik trials and isles for neitz helm if you dont want to use inquis helm ( requires 20 construction)
Get a fire cape if you didnt do it b4 nmz
Video of vyrewatch alt in action: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QDOmtmP5gbk
Best profif to afk ratio is only pick up addy plates, rune bar, rune ore, rune full helm, rune kites, and blood shards
Neitiznot Faceguard (million quests and reqs but worth if you want to use the alt for other stuff as well later i.e spec transfer or other pvm
Higher prayer level for longer afk
